name: comment-issue-link
description: Comment referencing another issue must use [[KEY]] marker, not markdown or hand-built ADF.
prompt: Přidej komentář k KNW-30344, že práce řeší i KNW-30718 (horizon 0–28). Příkaz jen navrhni, nespouštěj.
expected_behaviors: proposes `jira comment KNW-30344` with `[[KNW-30718]]` in the text
does not use `**KNW-30718**` or plain key without [[ ]] for the link
does not hand-construct inlineCard ADF JSON
does not use raw curl -X POST
anti_patterns: uses only plain text KNW-30718 expecting a JIRA issue card
